notes: Summary: Oxley is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to host a clinical-document search and patient support assistant. Primary concern: audit logging + SIEM integration for compliance with healthcare record regulations.
Stakeholders: CTO (A. Mendoza), Head of Security (L. Kline), Compliance Counsel (M. Hsu), Infra Lead (R. Patel).
Key ask on audit logging: must export structured JSON logs to their Splunk instance over TLS and optionally write to an S3 bucket within their account for long-term retention (immutable).
SIEM export requirements we discussed: syslog/CEF optional, preference for HTTP(S) JSON event stream or S3 delivery; support for push (webhook) and pull (S3) models.

Required schema fields they enumerated: timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, tenant_id/customer_id, user_id (hashed), actor_role, model, model_version, endpoint/route, latency_ms, token_count_in, token_count_out, prompt_hash, response_hash, decision_flags (safety/filtered), kv_cache_hit (true/false), egress_bytes.

Retention: Compliance team requests minimum 7 years retention for audit logs; security would like hot storage 90 days, warm 1 year, cold archive up to 7 years with immutability and WORM when required.

Access logs: must include VPC endpoint connection logs, IPs, instance id, and cross-account access events. They require RBAC audits tied to SSO identities and must be able to reconstruct replay of a specific request (prompt + metadata refs) without storing raw PII-sensitive prompt text (prefer hashed/pseudonymized prompt content).

KMS/HSM: integration must allow Redwood to encrypt audit exports with customer-managed keys (CMK) — Azure Key Vault + HSM support specifically called out. Key rotation and access logs for key usage are required.

Schema mapping: Oxley wants Redwood to provide a canonical JSON schema file (v1) and a Splunk CEF mapping template. They will supply field names in their SIEM; SE to deliver mapping and a sample 48-hour export for validation.

PII & minimization: Compliance insists Redwood provide configurable fields capture (toggle prompt text full/hashed/redacted), plus masking rules for PHI. Need explicit statement on whether Redwood stores full prompts in private deployment (they expect optional ephemeral cache only).
Network & egress: All audit exports must traverse private peering or VPC endpoint — no public internet egress. Discussed VPC peering + S3 endpoint + IAM role assumption for export.
Regulatory note: For certain jurisdictions of their patients, logs must be stored in NA data centers only — data residency constraint enforced at export location.
Quote from security lead: 'We need full fidelity logs to investigate clinical incidents, but we can't have raw PHI leaves the vault. The logs must be queryable in Splunk and tied to KMS events.'
Short-term POC: 2-week POC to validate log format, Splunk ingestion, KMS envelope encryption. SE to run simulated traffic and deliver log bundle.
